units.zh: 太祖神武元聖孝皇帝，姓朱氏，諱晃，本名溫，宋州碭山人。
units.en: Taizu, styled the Divine Martial, Primordially Sagely, Filial Emperor, was of the Zhu clan; his taboo name was Huang, his birth name Wen, and he came from Dangshan in Songzhou.
units.literal: Taizu, the Divine Martial, Primordially Sagely, Filial Emperor, bore the surname Zhu; his taboo name was Huang; his original name was Wen; he was a native of Dangshan in Song Prefecture.

units.zh: 其先，舜司徒虎之後。
units.en: His line traced back to Hu, Minister of Works in the age of Shun.
units.literal: His ancestors were descendants of Hu, Minister of Works under Shun.

units.zh: 高祖黯，曾祖茂琳，祖信，父誠。
units.en: His great-great-grandfather was An, his great-grandfather Maolin, his grandfather Xin, and his father Cheng.
units.literal: His great-great-grandfather was An; his great-grandfather Maolin; his grandfather Xin; his father Cheng.

units.zh: 帝即誠之第三子，母曰文惠王皇后。
units.en: The emperor was Cheng's third son; his mother was Empress Wenhui, née Wang.
units.literal: The Emperor was the third son of Cheng; his mother was called Empress Wenhui of the Wang clan.

units.zh: 《五代會要》：梁肅祖宣元皇帝諱黯，舜司徒虎四十二代孫；
units.en: The 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》 records that Liang's Sagely Ancestor, Emperor Xuan Yuan, taboo name An, was forty-second in descent from Shun's Minister of Works Hu;
units.literal: The 《Wudai huiyao》 says: The Sagely Ancestor of Liang, the Emperor Xuan Yuan, taboo name An, was the forty-second-generation descendant of Hu, Minister of Works under Shun;

units.zh: 開平元年七月，追尊宣元皇帝，廟號肅祖，葬興極陵。
units.en: In Kaiping 1.7 he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan Yuan, given the temple name Sagely Ancestor, and interred at Xingji Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Kaiping, he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan Yuan, with temple name Sagely Ancestor, and buried at Xingji Mausoleum.

units.zh: 敬祖光獻皇帝諱茂琳，宣元皇帝長子，母曰宣僖皇后范氏；
units.en: The Revered Ancestor, Emperor Guangxian, taboo Maolin, was the eldest son of Emperor Xuan Yuan; his mother was Honored Empress Xuanxi, née Fan;
units.literal: The Revered Ancestor, the Emperor Guangxian, taboo name Maolin, eldest son of Emperor Xuan Yuan, mother called the Honored Empress Xuanxi of the Fan clan;

units.zh: 開平元年七月，追尊光獻皇帝，廟號敬祖，葬永安陵。
units.en: In Kaiping 1.7 he was posthumously honored as Emperor Guangxian, given the temple name Revered Ancestor, and buried at Yong'an Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Kaiping, he was posthumously honored as Emperor Guangxian, with temple name Revered Ancestor, and buried at Yong'an Mausoleum.

units.zh: 憲祖昭武皇帝諱信，光獻皇帝長子，母曰光孝皇后楊氏；
units.en: The Exalted Ancestor, Emperor Zhaowu, taboo Xin, was the eldest son of Emperor Guangxian; his mother was Honored Empress Guangxiao, née Yang;
units.literal: The Exalted Ancestor, the Emperor Zhaowu, taboo name Xin, eldest son of Emperor Guangxian, mother called the Honored Empress Guangxiao of the Yang clan;

units.zh: 開平元年七月，追尊昭武皇帝，廟號憲祖，葬光天陵。
units.en: In Kaiping 1.7 he was posthumously honored as Emperor Zhaowu, given the temple name Exalted Ancestor, and buried at Guangtian Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Kaiping, he was posthumously honored as Emperor Zhaowu, with temple name Exalted Ancestor, and buried at Guangtian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 烈祖文穆皇帝諱誠，昭武皇帝長子，母曰昭懿皇后劉氏；
units.en: The August Ancestor, Emperor Wenmu, taboo Cheng, was the eldest son of Emperor Zhaowu; his mother was Honored Empress Zhaoyi, née Liu;
units.literal: The August Ancestor, the Emperor Wenmu, taboo name Cheng, eldest son of Emperor Zhaowu, mother called the Honored Empress Zhaoyi of the Liu clan;

units.zh: 開平元年七月，追尊文穆皇帝，廟號烈祖，葬咸寧陵。
units.en: In Kaiping 1.7 he was posthumously honored as Emperor Wenmu, given the temple name August Ancestor, and buried at Xianning Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Kaiping, he was posthumously honored as Emperor Wenmu, with temple name August Ancestor, and buried at Xianning Mausoleum.

units.zh: 以唐大中六年歲在壬申，十月二十一日夜，生於碭山縣午溝裏。
units.en: He was born in Dazhong 6, the year renshen, on the night of the twenty-first day of the tenth month, in Wugou village, Dangshan County.
units.literal: In the sixth year of the Dazhong era of Tang, the year in renshen, on the night of the twenty-first day of the tenth month, he was born in Wugou village, Dangshan County.

units.zh: 是夕，所居廬舍之上有赤氣上騰。
units.en: That night red vapor rose above the family's hut.
units.literal: That evening, above the thatched dwelling where they lived, red vapor rose upward.

units.zh: 里人望之，皆驚奔而來，曰：「朱家火發矣！」
units.en: Neighbors who saw it came running in alarm, crying, "The Zhu house is burning!"
units.literal: The villagers who saw it all ran in alarm, saying, "The Zhu household is on fire!"

units.zh: 及至，則廬舍儼然。
units.en: But when they reached the spot the hut stood untouched.
units.literal: When they arrived, the dwelling stood intact as before.

units.zh: 既入，鄰人以誕孩告眾，咸異之。
units.en: Inside, the neighbors told everyone a child had been born, and all took it as an omen.
units.literal: After they entered, the neighbors told everyone that a child had been born, and all regarded it as extraordinary.

units.zh: 昆仲三人，俱未冠而孤，母攜養寄於蕭縣人劉崇之家。
units.en: All three brothers lost their father before coming of age; their mother raised them as guests in the home of Liu Chong of Xiao County.
units.literal: The three brothers were all orphaned before coming of age, and their mother took them and raised them as dependents in the household of Liu Chong of Xiao County.

units.zh: 帝既壯，不事生業，以雄勇自負，里人多厭之。
units.en: As a young man he shunned honest work, swaggered in his strength, and was widely disliked in the neighborhood.
units.literal: When the Emperor had grown strong, he would not engage in livelihood; he prided himself on fierce courage, and many in the village disliked him.

units.zh: 崇以其慵惰，每加譴杖。
units.en: Chong beat him often for idleness.
units.literal: Chong, because of his laziness, often rebuked and beat him with the staff.

units.zh: 唯崇母自幼憐之，親為櫛發，嘗誡家人曰：「朱三非常人也，汝輩當善待之。」
units.en: Only Chong's mother had favored him since boyhood, combing his hair herself, and once told the family, "Zhu the Third is no ordinary man—you must treat him kindly."
units.literal: Only Chong's mother had pitied him from childhood, personally combing his hair, and once warned the household, saying, "Zhu the Third is no ordinary man; you should treat him well."

units.zh: 家人問其故，答曰：「我嘗見其熟寐之次，化為一赤蛇。」
units.en: When they asked why, she said, "Once, while he slept soundly, I saw him become a red serpent."
units.literal: The family asked the reason; she answered, "I once saw him in deep sleep transform into a red serpent."

units.zh: 然眾亦未之信也。
units.en: Still, no one quite believed her.
units.literal: Yet the crowd still did not believe it.

units.zh: 唐僖宗乾符中，關東荐饑，羣賊嘯聚。
units.en: During Xizong's Qianfu era, famine again and again struck Guandong, and rebel bands gathered.
units.literal: During the Qianfu era of Tang Xizong, famine repeatedly struck east of the passes and bands of rebels gathered with cries.

units.zh: 黃巢因之起于曹、濮，饑民願附者凡數萬。
units.en: Huang Chao rose out of Cao and Pu, drawing tens of thousands of starving followers.
units.literal: Huang Chao rose from Cao and Pu because of this, and starving people willing to attach themselves to him numbered in the tens of thousands.

units.zh: 帝乃辭崇家，與仲兄存俱入巢軍，以力戰屢捷，得補為隊長。
units.en: He left Chong's household, joined Chao's army with his elder brother Cun, and won promotion to squad leader through repeated victories.
units.literal: The emperor then left Chong's household and, together with his second elder brother Cun, entered Chao's army; because he fought hard and won repeatedly, he was appointed squad leader.

units.zh: 唐廣明元年十二月甲申，黃巢陷長安，遣帝領兵屯于東渭橋。
units.en: In Guangming 1.12, on jiashen, Huang Chao captured Chang'an and sent him to garrison East Wei Bridge.
units.literal: On jiashen day in the twelfth month of Tang Guangming 1, Huang Chao captured Chang'an and sent the emperor to lead troops to garrison East Wei Bridge.

units.zh: 是時，夏州節度使諸葛爽率所部屯于櫟陽，巢命帝招諭爽，爽遂降于巢。
units.en: Zhuge Shuang of Xiazhou was then camped at Liyang; Chao sent the emperor to win him over, and Shuang surrendered.
units.literal: At this time Zhuge Shuang, military governor of Xiazhou, led his troops to camp at Liyang; Chao ordered the emperor to summon and persuade Shuang, and Shuang then surrendered to Chao.

units.zh: 中和元年二月，巢以帝為東南面行營先鋒使，令攻南陽，下之。
units.en: In Zhonghe 1.2, Chao made him vanguard commissioner of the southeastern field army and ordered him against Nanyang, which he took.
units.literal: In the second month of Zhonghe 1, Chao made the emperor vanguard commissioner of the southeastern field army and ordered him to attack Nanyang, which he captured.

units.zh: 六月，帝歸長安，巢親勞于灞上。
units.en: In the sixth month he returned to Chang'an, where Chao personally honored him at Bashang.
units.literal: In the sixth month, the emperor returned to Chang'an, and Chao personally rewarded him at Bashang.

units.zh: 七月，巢遣帝西拒邠、岐、鄜、夏之師于興平，所至皆立功。
units.en: In the seventh month Chao sent him west to block the armies of Bin, Qi, Fu, and Xia at Xingping, and he won credit wherever he fought.
units.literal: In the seventh month, Chao sent the emperor west to resist the armies of Bin, Qi, Fu, and Xia at Xingping; wherever he went, he rendered merit.

units.zh: 二年二月，巢以帝為同州防禦使，使自攻取。
units.en: In the second month of the second year Huang Chao made him defender of Tongzhou and told him to seize the post on his own.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year, Chao appointed the Emperor Defender of Tong Prefecture and ordered him to take it himself.

units.zh: 帝乃自丹州南行，以擊左馮翊，拔之，遂據其郡。
units.en: He marched south from Danzhou, stormed Zuofengyi, and held the commandery.
units.literal: The Emperor then marched south from Dan Prefecture to strike Zuofengyi, captured it, and thereupon held that commandery.

units.zh: 時河中節度使王重榮屯兵數萬，糾合諸侯，以圖興復。
units.en: Wang Chongrong, governor of Hezhong, had tens of thousands in the field and was rallying the lords to restore the Tang.
units.literal: At that time Wang Chongrong, military governor of Hezhong, encamped tens of thousands of troops and rallied the feudatories to plan restoration.

units.zh: 帝時與之鄰封，屢為重榮所敗，遂請濟師於巢。
units.en: Bordering Chongrong's territory, he suffered repeated defeats and begged Chao for reinforcements.
units.literal: The Emperor was then on a neighboring border and was repeatedly defeated by Chongrong; he therefore requested reinforcements from Chao.

units.zh: 表章十上，為偽左軍使孟楷所蔽，不達。
units.en: He sent ten memorials, but Meng Kai, the rebel Left Army commissioner, blocked every one.
units.literal: He submitted memorials ten times, but they were concealed by the false Left Army Commissioner Meng Kai and did not get through.

units.zh: 又聞巢軍勢蹙，諸校離心，帝知其必敗。
units.en: Hearing that Chao's forces were failing and his officers wavering, he saw defeat coming.
units.literal: He also heard that Chao's army was pressed and that the officers were losing heart; the Emperor knew he was bound to fail.

units.zh: 九月，帝遂與左右定計，斬偽監軍使嚴實，舉郡降于重榮。
units.en: In the ninth month he plotted with his intimates, executed the rebel inspector Yan Shi, and surrendered his commandery to Chongrong.
units.literal: In the ninth month the Emperor then settled plans with his close attendants, beheaded the false military inspector Yan Shi, and surrendered the commandery to Chongrong.

units.zh: 重榮即日飛章上奏。
units.en: Chongrong that day rushed a memorial to the throne.
units.literal: Chongrong that same day sent a flying memorial to report upward.

units.zh: 時僖宗在蜀，覽表而喜曰：「是天賜予也！」
units.en: Emperor Xizong, then in Shu, read the report and exclaimed, "Heaven has sent him to me!"
units.literal: At that time Emperor Xizong was in Shu; reading the memorial he rejoiced and said, "Heaven has given him to me!"

units.zh: 乃詔授帝左金吾衛大將軍，充河中行營副招討使。
units.en: He appointed him Grand General of the Left Golden Guard and deputy campaign commissioner of the Hezhong field army.
units.literal: He then issued an edict appointing the Emperor Grand General of the Left Golden Guard and making him deputy campaign commissioner of the Hezhong field army.

units.zh: 仍賜名全忠。
units.en: The court also granted him the name Quanzhong—"wholly loyal."
units.literal: He was also granted the name Quanzhong.

units.zh: 自是率所部與河中兵士偕行，所向無不克捷。
units.en: From then on he fought beside the Hezhong army and won wherever he turned.
units.literal: From then on he led his troops together with the soldiers of Hezhong, and wherever they went there was nothing that did not meet with swift victory.

units.zh: 三年三月，僖宗制授帝宣武軍節度使，依前充河中行營副招討使，仍令候收復京闕，即得赴鎮。
units.en: In the third month of the third year Xizong named him military governor of Xuanwu, kept him as Hezhong's deputy campaign commissioner, and told him to take up the post once the capital was recovered.
units.literal: In the third month of the third year, Emperor Xizong by imperial order appointed the Emperor military governor of the Xuanwu army, continuing as before as deputy campaign commissioner of the Hezhong field army, and still ordered that once the capital passes were recovered he might proceed to his post.

units.zh: 四月，巢軍自藍關南走，帝與諸侯之師俱收長安，乃率部下一旅之眾，仗節東下。
units.en: In the fourth month, as Chao fled south through Languan, he joined the allied armies in retaking Chang'an, then marched east at the head of a detachment.
units.literal: In the fourth month Chao's army fled south through Languan Pass; the Emperor together with the armies of the feudatories recovered Chang'an, then led a detachment of his command east under his commission.

units.zh: 七月丁卯，入于梁苑。
units.en: On dingmao day in the seventh month he entered Liang Park.
units.literal: On dingmao day of the seventh month he entered Liang Park.

units.zh: 是時，帝年三十有二。
units.en: He was thirty-two years old.
units.literal: At that time the Emperor was thirty-two years old.

units.zh: 時蔡州刺史秦宗權與黃巢餘孽合從肆虐，共圍陳州。
units.en: Qin Zongquan of Cai Prefecture had joined Huang Chao's remnants in ravaging the countryside and was besieging Chenzhou.
units.literal: At that time Qin Zongquan, prefect of Cai Prefecture, joined with the remnants of Huang Chao to run riot together and jointly besieged Chen Prefecture.

units.zh: 久之，僖宗乃命帝為東北面都招討使。
units.en: Only after long delay did Xizong name him grand campaign commissioner of the northeast.
units.literal: After a long time, Emperor Xizong then ordered the Emperor to be Grand Campaign Commissioner of the Northeast.

units.zh: 時汴、宋連年阻饑，公私俱困，帑廩皆虛，外為大敵所攻，內則驕軍難制，交鋒接戰，日甚一日；
units.en: Bian and Song had suffered famine for years; treasuries were empty, a great enemy pressed from without, unruly troops within, and fighting grew fiercer by the day;
units.literal: At that time Bian and Song had suffered famine year after year; public and private were alike distressed, the treasuries were empty, outside they were attacked by a great enemy, inside the arrogant troops were hard to control, and clashes in battle grew worse day by day;

units.zh: 人皆危之，惟帝銳氣益振。
units.en: others despaired, but his fighting spirit only rose.
units.literal: All men regarded the situation as perilous, but only the Emperor's keen spirit grew ever stronger.

units.zh: 是歲十二月，帝領兵于鹿邑，與巢眾相遇，縱兵擊之，斬首二千餘級，乃引兵入亳州，因是兼有譙郡之地。
units.en: That twelfth month he met Chao's band at Luyi, routed them, and took more than two thousand heads; he then entered Bozhou and with it gained Qiao commandery.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of that year the Emperor led troops at Luyi, met Chao's horde, loosed his soldiers to strike them, and cut off more than two thousand heads; he then led his army into Bozhou and thereby also gained the territory of Qiao commandery.

units.zh: 四年春，帝與許州田從異諸軍同收瓦子寨，殺賊數萬眾。
units.en: In the spring of the fourth year he joined Tian Congyi of Xuzhou and others to take Wazi Stockade and kill tens of thousands of rebels.
units.literal: In the spring of the fourth year the Emperor together with the armies of Tian Congyi of Xuzhou and others jointly recovered Wazi Stockade and killed tens of thousands of the bandits.

units.zh: 是時，陳州四面，賊寨相望，驅擄編氓，殺以充食，號為「舂磨寨」。
units.en: Rebel camps ringed Chenzhou on every side, dragging off civilians to kill for food in camps they called "Pounding and Grinding."
units.literal: At that time on all four sides of Chen Prefecture rebel stockades faced one another; they drove off and seized common folk, killing them for food, and called them "Pounding and Grinding Stockades."

units.zh: 帝分兵翦撲，大小凡四十戰。
units.en: He sent detachments to destroy them in forty engagements large and small.
units.literal: The Emperor divided his forces to cut them down; in large and small engagements there were forty battles in all.

units.zh: 四月丁巳，收西華寨，賊將黃鄴單騎奔陳。
units.en: On dingsi day in the fourth month he took Xihua Stockade; the rebel Huang Ye fled alone into Chen.
units.literal: On dingsi day of the fourth month he recovered Xihua Stockade; the rebel general Huang Ye fled alone on horseback to Chen.

units.zh: 帝乘勝追之，鼓噪而進。
units.en: He pressed the pursuit with drums and shouts.
units.literal: The Emperor pursued in victory, advancing with drums and shouts.

units.zh: 會黃巢遁去，遂入陳州，刺史趙犨迎于馬前。
units.en: Huang Chao had already fled; he entered Chenzhou, where Prefect Zhao Chou met him at his horse.
units.literal: Just then Huang Chao had slipped away, so he entered Chen Prefecture, and the prefect Zhao Chou welcomed him before his horse.

units.zh: 俄聞巢黨尚在陳北故陽壘，帝遂逕歸大梁。
units.en: Learning that Chao's men still held the old Yang camp north of the city, he marched straight back to Daliang.
units.literal: Soon he heard that Chao's partisans were still at the old Yang stockade north of Chen; the Emperor then went straight back to Great Liang.

units.zh: 是時，河東節度使李克用奉僖宗詔，統騎軍數千同謀破賊，與帝合勢于中牟北邀擊之，賊眾大敗于王滿渡，多束手來降。
units.en: Li Keyong of Hedong, under imperial orders, brought thousands of horsemen to join him; north of Zhongmou they smashed the rebels at Wangman Ford, and many surrendered with hands bound.
units.literal: At that time Li Keyong, military governor of Hedong, obeying Emperor Xizong's edict, commanded several thousand cavalry to join in breaking the bandits; he united his strength with the Emperor north of Zhongmou to intercept them, and the rebel horde suffered a great defeat at Wangman Ford; many came with bound hands to surrender.

units.zh: 時賊將霍存、葛從周、張歸厚、張歸霸皆匍匐于馬前，悉宥而納之，遂逐殘寇，東至於冤句。
units.en: Rebel generals Huo Cun, Ge Congzhou, Zhang Guihou, and Zhang Guiba threw themselves before his horse; he spared them and enrolled them, then chased the survivors east to Yuanju.
units.literal: At that time the rebel generals Huo Cun, Ge Congzhou, Zhang Guihou, and Zhang Guiba all prostrated themselves before his horse; he pardoned and enrolled them all, then pursued the remnant bandits east as far as Yuanju.

units.zh: 五月甲戌，帝與晉軍振旅歸汴，館克用於上源驛。
units.en: On jiaxu day in the fifth month he returned to Bian with Keyong's army and lodged Keyong at Shangyuan Post.
units.literal: On jiaxu day of the fifth month the Emperor together with the Jin army raised the banners and returned to Bian, lodging Keyong at Shangyuan Post.

units.zh: 既而備犒宴之禮，克用乘醉任氣，帝不平之。
units.en: He prepared a reward feast, but Keyong, drunk and overbearing, angered him.
units.literal: Thereafter he prepared a feast with rewards; Keyong, drunk, gave free rein to his temper, and the Emperor was displeased.

units.zh: 是夜，命甲士圍而攻之。
units.en: That night he sent armored men to surround and attack him.
units.literal: That night he ordered armored soldiers to surround and attack him.

units.zh: 會大雨雷電，克用因得於電光中逾垣遁去，惟殺其部下數百人而已。
units.en: A thunderstorm broke; Keyong leapt the wall in a flash of lightning and escaped, though several hundred of his men were killed.
units.literal: Just then great rain and thunder and lightning came; Keyong therefore was able in a flash of lightning to leap the wall and escape, and only several hundred of his subordinates were killed.

units.zh: 六月，陳人感解圍之惠，為帝建生祠堂於其郡。
units.en: In the sixth month the people of Chen, grateful for the relief of the siege, built him a living shrine in their prefecture.
units.literal: In the sixth month the people of Chen, grateful for the favor of lifting the siege, built a living shrine to the Emperor in their commandery.

units.zh: 是歲，黃巢雖歿，而蔡州秦宗權繼為巨孽，有眾數萬，攻陷鄰郡，殺掠吏民，屠害之酷，更甚巢賊，帝患之。
units.en: Though Huang Chao was dead, Qin Zongquan of Cai became an even greater scourge, with tens of thousands of men ravaging neighboring prefectures with cruelty worse than Chao's; the emperor brooded over him.
units.literal: That year, although Huang Chao had died, Qin Zongquan of Cai Prefecture succeeded him as a great scourge, with tens of thousands of men; he attacked and seized neighboring commanderies, killed and plundered officials and people, and his slaughter was more cruel than even Chao's bandits; the Emperor was troubled by him.

units.zh: 七月，遂與陳人共攻蔡賊于溵水，殺數千人。
units.en: In the seventh month he joined the Chenzhou men to strike Qin's men at Yinshui and kill several thousand.
units.literal: In the seventh month he then together with the people of Chen attacked the Cai bandits at Yinshui and killed several thousand men.

units.zh: 九月己未，僖宗就加帝檢校司徒、同平章事，封沛郡侯，食邑千戶。
units.en: On jiwei day in the ninth month Xizong promoted him to acting Minister of Works and co-rector of state, enfeoffed him as Marquis of Pei with a thousand-household fief.
units.literal: On jiwei day of the ninth month Emperor Xizong added to his titles the Emperor as Acting Minister of Works and Co-Rector of State, enfeoffed him as Marquis of Pei commandery with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 光啟元年春，蔡賊掠亳、頴二郡，帝帥師以救之，遂東至于焦夷，敗賊眾數千，生擒賊將鐵林，梟首以狥軍而還。
units.en: In the spring of Guangqi 1, Cai rebels raided Bo and Ying. He marched to relieve them, defeated several thousand rebels at Jiaoyi, captured the rebel general Tielin, displayed his head to warn the army, and returned.
units.literal: In the spring of Guangqi 1, the Cai rebels plundered the two commanderies of Bo and Ying; the emperor led his army to rescue them, advanced east to Jiaoyi, defeated several thousand rebels, captured the rebel general Tielin alive, displayed his head as a warning to the army, and returned.

units.zh: 三月，僖宗自蜀還長安，改元光啟。
units.en: In the third month Xizong returned from Shu to Chang'an and proclaimed the Guangqi era.
units.literal: In the third month, Xizong returned from Shu to Chang'an and changed the era name to Guangqi.

units.zh: 四月戊辰，就加帝檢校太保，增食邑千五百戶。
units.en: On wuchen in the fourth month he was promoted to acting Grand Guardian and granted another fifteen hundred fief households.
units.literal: On wuchen day in the fourth month, the emperor was promoted in place to acting Grand Guardian, and fifteen hundred households were added to his fief.

units.zh: 十二月，河中、太原之師逼長安，觀軍容使田令孜奉僖宗出幸鳳翔。
units.en: In the twelfth month the armies of Hezhong and Taiyuan threatened Chang'an, and Tian Lingzi escorted Xizong to Fengxiang.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, the armies of Hezhong and Taiyuan pressed Chang'an, and Tian Lingzi, commissioner for inspecting army dispositions, escorted Xizong out to Fengxiang.

units.zh: 二年春，蔡賊益熾。
units.en: In the spring of the second year the Cai rebels grew bolder still.
units.literal: In the spring of the second year the Cai bandits grew fiercer still.

units.zh: 時唐室微弱，諸道州兵不為王室所用，故宗權得以縱毒，連陷汝、洛、懷、孟、唐、鄧、許、鄭，圜幅數千里，殆絕人煙，惟宋、亳、滑、潁僅能閉壘而已。
units.en: The Tang court was feeble and provincial armies served their own masters, so Zongquan ran unchecked through Ru, Luo, Huai, Meng, Tang, Deng, Xu, and Zheng—a wasteland thousands of li wide—while only Song, Bo, Hua, and Ying could still hold their walls.
units.literal: At that time the Tang house was weak; the troops of the various circuits and prefectures were not used for the royal house, so Zongquan was able to run wild; he successively seized Ru, Luo, Huai, Meng, Tang, Deng, Xu, and Zheng, a circuit of several thousand li where human life nearly ceased, and only Song, Bo, Hua, and Ying could barely shut their walls.

units.zh: 帝累出兵與之交戰，然或勝或負，人甚危之。
units.en: He fought them again and again with mixed success, and men grew fearful.
units.literal: The Emperor repeatedly led troops out to fight them, yet sometimes he won and sometimes he lost, and men regarded the situation as very perilous.

units.zh: 三月庚辰，僖宗降制就封帝為沛郡王。
units.en: On gengchen day in the third month Xizong enfeoffed him as Prince of Pei.
units.literal: On gengchen day of the third month Emperor Xizong by edict enfeoffed the Emperor as Prince of Pei commandery.

units.zh: 是月，僖宗移幸興元。
units.en: That month Xizong moved his court to Xingyuan.
units.literal: That month Emperor Xizong moved his residence to Xingyuan.

units.zh: 五月，嗣襄王煴僭即帝位于長安，改元為建貞。
units.en: In the fifth month the heir Prince of Xiang, Yun, usurped the throne at Chang'an and proclaimed the era Jianzhen.
units.literal: In the fifth month the heir Prince of Xiang, Yun, presumptuously took the imperial throne at Chang'an and changed the era name to Jianzhen.

units.zh: 遣使齎偽詔至汴，帝命焚之於庭。
units.en: When a forged edict reached Bian, he had it burned in the courtyard.
units.literal: He sent envoys bearing a false edict to Bian; the Emperor ordered it burned in the courtyard.

units.zh: 未幾，襄王果敗。
units.en: Before long the Prince of Xiang was overthrown.
units.literal: Before long the Prince of Xiang was indeed defeated.

units.zh: 七月，蔡人逼許州，節度使鹿宴宏使來求救，帝遣葛從周等率師赴援。
units.en: In the seventh month Cai forces besieged Xuzhou; Governor Lu Yanhong begged for aid, and he sent Ge Congzhou to relieve the city.
units.literal: In the seventh month the men of Cai pressed Xuzhou; the military governor Lu Yanhong sent to beg rescue; the Emperor dispatched Ge Congzhou and others to lead troops to the relief.

units.zh: 師未至而城陷，宴宏為蔡賊所害。
units.en: The relief army arrived too late; the city fell and Yanhong was killed.
units.literal: The army had not yet arrived when the city fell, and Yanhong was killed by the Cai bandits.

units.zh: 十一月，滑州節度使安師儒以怠於軍政，為部下所殺。
units.en: In the eleventh month An Shiru of Huazhou, negligent in military affairs, was murdered by his own men.
units.literal: In the eleventh month An Shiru, military governor of Hua Prefecture, because he was slack in military affairs, was killed by his subordinates.

units.zh: 帝聞之，乃遣朱珍、李唐賓襲而取之，由是遂有滑台之地。
units.en: Hearing of it, he sent Zhu Zhen and Li Tangbin to seize the province and thereby gained Huatai.
units.literal: When the Emperor heard of it, he sent Zhu Zhen and Li Tangbin to strike and take it, and thereby gained the territory of Huatai.

units.zh: 十二月，僖宗降制就加帝檢校太傅，改封吳興郡王，食邑三千戶。
units.en: In the twelfth month Xizong promoted him to acting Grand Tutor and changed his title to Prince of Wuxing with a three-thousand-household fief.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Emperor Xizong by edict added to his titles the Emperor as Acting Grand Tutor, changed his enfeoffment to Prince of Wuxing commandery with a fief of three thousand households.

units.zh: 是歲，鄭州為蔡賊所陷，刺史李璠單騎來奔，帝宥而納之，以為行軍司馬。
units.en: That year Zhengzhou fell to the Cai rebels; Prefect Li Fan fled alone on horseback; he pardoned him and made him campaigning staff officer.
units.literal: That year Zheng Prefecture was seized by the Cai bandits; the prefect Li Fan came fleeing alone on horseback; the Emperor pardoned and enrolled him, making him campaigning staff officer.

units.zh: 宗權既得鄭，益驕，帝遣裨將邏于金隄驛，與賊相遇，因擊之，賊眾大敗，追至武陽橋，斬首千餘級。
units.en: Emboldened by taking Zheng, Zongquan grew arrogant; a patrol at Jindi Post routed his men and pursued them to Wuyang Bridge, taking more than a thousand heads.
units.literal: Once Zongquan had taken Zheng he grew more arrogant; the Emperor sent a subordinate general to patrol at Jindi Post, met the bandits, and struck them; the rebel horde suffered a great defeat; they pursued them to Wuyang Bridge and cut off more than a thousand heads.

units.zh: 帝每與蔡人戰於四郊，既以少擊眾，常出奇以制之，但患師少，未快其旨。
units.en: Fighting the Cai men in the suburbs with inferior numbers, he relied on surprise, but always wished for more troops.
units.literal: Whenever the Emperor fought the men of Cai on the four outskirts, because he used the few to strike the many he often employed surprise to control them, but he only worried that his forces were too few and could not fully satisfy his intent.

units.zh: 宗權又以己眾十倍於帝，恥於頻敗，乃誓眾堅決以攻夷門。
units.en: Shamed by repeated defeat despite outnumbering him ten to one, Zongquan swore his army to a final assault on Yimen.
units.literal: Zongquan also, because his forces were ten times the Emperor's, was shamed by frequent defeat and therefore swore his masses to a firm resolve to attack Yimen.

units.zh: 既而獲蔡之諜者，備知其事，遂謀濟師焉。
units.en: Capturing a Cai spy, he learned the plan and set about raising reinforcements.
units.literal: Soon afterward they captured a spy of Cai and learned the whole affair in detail, and thereupon planned to bring in reinforcements.

units.zh: 三年春二月乙巳，承制以朱珍為淄州刺史，俾募兵於東道，且慮蔡人暴其麥苗，期以夏首回歸。
units.en: On yisi day in the second month of the third year he commissioned Zhu Zhen prefect of Zi to recruit on the eastern circuit, planning to return by early summer before the Cai men could trample the wheat.
units.literal: On yisi day of the second month of the spring of the third year, by imperial commission Zhu Zhen was made prefect of Zi Prefecture, so that he might recruit troops on the eastern circuit, and because they feared the Cai men would ravage the wheat seedlings, they set the time of return for the beginning of summer.

units.zh: 珍既至淄、棣，旬日之內，應募者萬餘人。
units.en: Within ten days at Zi and Di he raised more than ten thousand men.
units.literal: Once Zhen had reached Zi and Di, within ten days more than ten thousand men answered the call.

units.zh: 又潛襲青州，獲馬千匹，鎧甲稱是，乃鼓行而歸。
units.en: He also raided Qingzhou for a thousand horses and matching armor, then marched back in triumph.
units.literal: He also secretly raided Qing Prefecture, obtained a thousand horses, and armor in proportion; he then marched back with drums beating.

units.zh: 四月辛亥，達於夷門。
units.en: On xinhai day in the fourth month he reached Yimen.
units.literal: On xinhai day of the fourth month he reached Yimen.

units.zh: 帝喜曰：「吾事濟矣。」
units.en: The emperor exclaimed, "My cause is saved."
units.literal: The Emperor rejoiced and said, "My affair is accomplished."

units.zh: 是時，賊將張晊屯於北郊，秦賢屯於版橋，各有眾數萬，樹柵相連二十餘里，其勢甚盛。
units.en: Zhang Zhi held the northern suburbs and Qin Xian Banqiao, each with tens of thousands in camps strung twenty li, and their strength seemed overwhelming.
units.literal: At that time the rebel general Zhang Zhi was encamped at the northern suburb and Qin Xian at Banqiao, each with tens of thousands of men; they built stockades linked for more than twenty li, and their momentum was very strong.

units.zh: 帝謂諸將曰：「此賊方今息師蓄銳以俟時，必來攻我。
units.en: He told his generals, "The enemy is resting and sharpening his edge; he will surely attack us.
units.literal: The Emperor told the generals, "These bandits are now resting their troops and storing their edge to await the moment; they are sure to come attack us.

units.zh: 況宗權度我兵少，又未知珍來，謂吾畏懼，止於堅守而已。
units.en: Zongquan thinks us few, does not know Zhen has arrived, and expects us only to cower behind the walls.
units.literal: Moreover Zongquan gauged our few troops and also did not yet know that Zhen had come; he thought we were afraid and would only hold firm defense.

units.zh: 今出不意，不如先擊之。」
units.en: Strike before he expects it—attack first."
units.literal: Now, striking where they do not expect it, it would be better to attack them first."

units.zh: 乃親引兵攻秦賢寨，將士踴躍爭先，賊果不備，連拔四寨，斬首萬餘級，時賊眾以為神助。
units.en: He led the assault on Qin Xian's camp himself; his men rushed the unprepared rebels, took four camps in succession, and killed more than ten thousand—the enemy thought heaven fought for him.
units.literal: He then personally led troops to attack Qin Xian's stockade; officers and soldiers leaped forward competing to be first; the bandits were indeed unprepared; they successively took four stockades and cut off more than ten thousand heads; at that time the rebel masses regarded it as divine aid.

units.zh: 庚午，賊將盧瑭領萬餘人于圃田北萬勝戍，夾汴水為營，跨河為梁，以扼運路。
units.en: On gengwu day Lu Yan held Wansheng garrison north of Putian with ten thousand men, camped on both banks of the Bian River, and bridged it to choke supply lines.
units.literal: On gengwu day the rebel general Lu Yan led more than ten thousand men at Wansheng garrison north of Putian, made camps on both banks of the Bian River, and spanned the river with a bridge to choke the transport route.

units.zh: 帝擇精銳以襲之。
units.en: He chose elite troops for a surprise attack.
units.literal: The Emperor chose crack troops to strike them.

units.zh: 是日昏霧四合，兵及賊壘方覺，遂突入掩殺，赴水死者甚眾，盧瑭自投於河。
units.en: Dusk fog hid the assault until they were on the camp; they slaughtered the garrison; many drowned; Lu Yan threw himself into the river.
units.literal: That day the four quarters were wrapped in dusk fog; the soldiers reached the rebel stockade before they were noticed; they then burst in to cover and kill; very many died in the water; Lu Yan himself threw himself into the river.

units.zh: 河南諸賊連敗，不敢復駐，皆並在張晊寨。
units.en: Defeated rebels across Henan fled to Zhang Zhi's camp.
units.literal: The bandits of Henan, defeated in succession, did not dare stay again; all gathered in Zhang Zhi's stockade.

units.zh: 自是蔡寇皆懷震讋，往往軍中自相驚亂。
units.en: From then on the Cai army shook with fear and panicked at shadows.
units.literal: From then on the men of Cai all harbored dread and trembling, and often in the army they alarmed one another.

units.zh: 帝旋師休息，大行犒賞，由是軍士各懷憤激，每遇敵，無不奮勇。
units.en: He rested his army and lavished rewards until every soldier burned to fight.
units.literal: The Emperor withdrew his army to rest and carried out great rewards and feasts; thereby the soldiers each harbored fierce zeal, and whenever they met the enemy there was none who did not fight bravely.

units.zh: 五月丙子，出酸棗門，自卯至未，短兵相接，賊眾大敗，追斬二十餘里，僵僕就枕。
units.en: On bingzi day in the fifth month he sallied from Suanzao Gate and from mao to wei fought hand to hand; the rebels broke; pursuit ran twenty li with the dead piled like pillows.
units.literal: On bingzi day of the fifth month he went out through the Suanzao Gate; from mao to wei they fought hand to hand at close quarters; the rebel masses suffered a great defeat; they pursued and cut them down for more than twenty li; the fallen lay pillow to pillow.

units.zh: 宗權恥敗，益縱其虐，乃自鄭州親領突將數人，徑入張晊寨。
units.en: Humiliated, Zongquan turned more savage and rode from Zhengzhou with picked raiders into Zhang Zhi's camp.
units.literal: Zongquan, shamed by defeat, grew more wanton in his cruelty; he himself from Zheng Prefecture led a few picked shock troops and went straight into Zhang Zhi's stockade.

units.zh: 其日晚，大星隕於賊壘，有聲如雷。
units.en: That evening a great star fell on the rebel camp with a thunderous crash.
units.literal: That evening a great star fell in the rebel stockade with a sound like thunder.

units.zh: 辛巳，兗、鄆、滑軍士皆來赴援，乃陳兵于汴水之上，旌旗器甲甚盛。
units.en: On xinsi day reinforcements from Yan, Yun, and Hua arrived; he paraded them on the Bian River in splendid array.
units.literal: On xinsi day the soldiers of Yan, Yun, and Hua all came to bring relief; they then arrayed troops on the Bian River; banners, flags, weapons, and armor were very splendid.

units.zh: 蔡人望之，不敢出寨。
units.en: The Cai men looked on and dared not leave their camp.
units.literal: The men of Cai gazed at them and did not dare leave the stockade.

units.zh: 翌日，分佈諸軍，齊攻賊寨，自寅至申，斬首二萬餘級。
units.en: The next day he arrayed his forces for a joint assault on the rebel camps; from yin to shen they took more than twenty thousand heads.
units.literal: The next day he deployed the armies and attacked the rebel stockades together; from the yin hour to the shen hour they cut off more than twenty thousand heads.

units.zh: 會夜收軍，獲牛馬、輜重、生口、器甲不可勝計。
units.en: At night he drew off the army with cattle, horses, supplies, prisoners, and arms in incalculable quantity.
units.literal: At nightfall he withdrew the army, having seized cattle, horses, baggage trains, captives, and armor beyond reckoning.

units.zh: 是夜，宗權、晊遁去，遲明追之，至陽武橋而還。
units.en: That night Zongquan and Zhi escaped; at dawn he pursued them to Yangwu Bridge and turned back.
units.literal: That night Zongquan and Zhi fled; at first light he pursued them to Yangwu Bridge and then returned.

units.zh: 宗權至鄭州，乃盡焚其廬舍，屠其郡人而去。
units.en: Reaching Zhengzhou, Zongquan burned the city to the ground, massacred its people, and fled.
units.literal: When Zongquan reached Zheng Prefecture he burned every dwelling, slaughtered the people of the prefecture, and departed.

units.zh: 始蔡人分兵寇陝、洛、孟、懷、許、汝，皆先據之，因是敗也，賊眾恐懼，鹹棄之而遁。
units.en: The Cai rebels had earlier garrisoned Shan, Luoyang, Meng, Huai, Xu, and Ru; now, shattered in defeat, they abandoned every post and fled in terror.
units.literal: At first the men of Cai had divided their forces to raid Shan, Luo, Meng, Huai, Xu, and Ru, and had all seized them first; because of this defeat the rebel masses were terrified and all abandoned them and fled.

units.zh: 帝乃慎選將佐，俾完葺壁壘，為戰守之備，於是遠近流亡復歸者眾矣。
units.en: He chose his officers with care, had the walls restored and defenses readied, and refugees streamed back from far and near.
units.literal: The Emperor then carefully chose generals and aides and had them repair the walls and ramparts and prepare for war and defense; thereupon many refugees near and far returned.

units.zh: 是時，揚州節度使高駢為裨將畢師鐸所害，復有孫儒、楊行密互相攻伐，朝廷不能制，乃就加帝檢校太尉，兼領淮南節度使。
units.en: Gao Pian of Yangzhou had fallen to Bi Shiduo; Sun Ru and Yang Xingmi were tearing Huainan apart beyond the court's control, and the throne therefore promoted the emperor to acting Grand Commandant with concurrent command of Huainan.
units.literal: At that time the military governor of Yangzhou, Gao Pian, had been killed by his vice-general Bi Shiduo; Sun Ru and Yang Xingmi were again attacking one another, and the court could not control them; the court thereupon added to the Emperor the acting post of Grand Commandant and concurrently made him military governor of Huainan.

units.zh: 九月，亳州裨將謝殷逐刺史宋袞，自據其郡；
units.en: In the ninth month Xie Yin, a Bozhou officer, drove out Prefect Song Gun and seized the commandery;
units.literal: In the ninth month the Bozhou vice-general Xie Yin expelled the prefect Song Gun and seized the prefecture for himself;

units.zh: 帝親領軍屯于太清宮，遣霍存討平之。
units.en: the emperor marched in person to the Supreme Unity Palace and sent Huo Cun to crush the revolt.
units.literal: the Emperor personally led his army to encamp at the Supreme Unity Palace and sent Huo Cun to suppress and pacify him.

units.zh: 帝之禦蔡寇也，鄆州朱瑄、兗州朱瑾皆領兵來援。
units.en: While he fought the Cai rebels, Zhu Xuan of Yanzhou and Zhu Jin of Yunzhou both marched to his aid.
units.literal: When the Emperor was resisting the Cai bandits, Zhu Xuan of Yan Prefecture and Zhu Jin of Yun Prefecture had both led troops to his aid.

units.zh: 及宗權既敗，帝以瑄、瑾宗人也，又有力於己，皆厚禮以歸之。
units.en: After Zongquan's defeat he sent Xuan and Jin home with rich honors—they were kinsmen who had fought for him.
units.literal: After Zongquan was defeated, the Emperor, considering that Xuan and Jin were men of his clan and had exerted themselves on his behalf, treated them with generous rites and sent them home.

units.zh: 瑄、瑾以帝軍士勇悍，私心愛之，乃密于曹、濮界上懸金帛以誘之，帝軍利其貨而赴者甚眾，帝乃移檄以讓之。
units.en: Admiring his fierce troops, Xuan and Jin secretly offered gold and silk on the Cao–Pu border to lure deserters; so many men went that the emperor rebuked them in writing.
units.literal: Xuan and Jin, because the Emperor's soldiers were fierce and bold, privately admired them; they secretly hung gold and silks on the Cao–Pu border to lure them, and very many of the Emperor's troops went for the goods; the Emperor then sent a written protest rebuking them.

units.zh: 朱瑄來詞不遜，乃命朱珍侵曹伐濮，以懲其奸。
units.en: Zhu Xuan answered with insolence; the emperor sent Zhu Zhen into Cao and Pu to punish their treachery.
units.literal: Zhu Xuan came with insolent words; the Emperor then ordered Zhu Zhen to invade Cao and attack Pu to punish their treachery.

units.zh: 未幾，珍伐曹州，執刺史丘禮以獻，遂移兵圍濮。
units.en: Soon Zhu Zhen took Cao, captured Prefect Qiu Li, and turned to besiege Pu.
units.literal: Before long Zhen attacked Cao Prefecture, seized the prefect Qiu Li and presented him, then shifted his troops to besiege Pu.

units.zh: 兗、鄆之釁，自茲而始矣。
units.en: The feud between Yan and Yun began here.
units.literal: The strife of Yan and Yun began from this.

units.zh: 《通鑒考異》引高若拙《後史補》云：「梁太祖皇帝到梁園，深有大志。
units.en: The 《Zizhi Tongjian: Examination of Discrepancies》 quotes Gao Ruozhuo's 《Supplement to the Later History》: "When Liang's founding emperor came to Liang Garden, his ambition burned bright.
units.literal: The 《Examination of Discrepancies in the Comprehensive Mirror》 cites Gao Ruozhuo's 《Supplement to the Later History》, saying: "When the Founding Emperor of Liang arrived at Liang Garden, his ambition ran very deep.

units.zh: 然兵力不足，常欲外掠；
units.en: Yet his forces were too few, and he longed to raid beyond his borders;
units.literal: Yet his troops were insufficient and he often wished to raid outward;

units.zh: 又虞四境之難，每有鬱然之狀。
units.en: yet he feared attack from every side and often looked troubled.
units.literal: he also feared trouble on the four frontiers and often wore a troubled look.

units.zh: 時有薦敬秀才于門下，乃白梁祖曰：'明公方欲圖大事，輜重必為四境所侵。
units.en: Someone then recommended Scholar Jing, who told the Liang founder: 'My lord aims at great things, yet your baggage will be prey on every frontier.
units.literal: At that time someone recommended the scholar Jing at his gate; he reported to the Liang Ancestor, saying: 'My lord now wishes to accomplish a great affair; your baggage train will surely be harried on every side.

units.zh: 但令麾下將士詐為叛者而逃，即明公奏於主上，及告四鄰，以自襲叛徒為名。
units.en: Let your officers pretend to desert and flee; then report to the throne and the neighboring powers that you are punishing traitors in your own ranks.'
units.literal: Only order your generals to feign desertion and flee; then my lord can memorialize the sovereign and inform the four neighbors, taking as your pretext that you yourself are attacking deserters.'

units.zh: '梁祖曰：'天降奇人，以佐於吾。
units.en: The founder replied: 'Heaven has sent me a wonder to aid my cause.'
units.literal: The Liang Ancestor said: 'Heaven has sent me an extraordinary man to assist me.'

units.zh: '初從其議，一出而致眾十倍。」
units.en: He took the counsel; one raid swelled his army tenfold."
units.literal: At first he followed this plan; with one sortie his forces increased tenfold."

units.zh: 十月，僖宗命水部郎中王贊撰紀功碑以賜帝。
units.en: In the tenth month Xizong ordered Wang Zan of the Waterways Bureau to compose a merit stele and bestow it on the emperor.
units.literal: In the tenth month Emperor Xizong ordered the Director of the Waterways Bureau Wang Zan to compose a stele recording merit and bestow it on the Emperor.

units.zh: 是月，帝親帥騎數千巡師於濮上，因破朱瑄援師于範縣。
units.en: That month he led several thousand horsemen on patrol along the Pu front and routed Zhu Xuan's relief column at Fan County.
units.literal: That month the Emperor personally led several thousand horsemen to review the army on the Pu frontier and thereby defeated Zhu Xuan's relief force at Fan County.

units.zh: 丁未，攻陷濮州，刺史朱裕單騎奔鄆。
units.en: On dingwei he took Pu; Prefect Zhu Yu rode alone to Yanzhou.
units.literal: On dingwei day he stormed Pu Prefecture; the prefect Zhu Yu fled alone on horseback to Yun.

units.zh: 尋為鄆人所敗，逾月乃還。
units.en: Soon the men of Yun defeated him, and he did not return for more than a month.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was defeated by the men of Yun; only after more than a month did he return.

units.zh: 十二月，僖宗遣使賜帝鐵券，又命翰林承旨劉崇望撰德政碑以賜帝。
units.en: In the twelfth month Xizong sent an iron certificate of grace and had Liu Chongwang, Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance, compose a stele praising his governance.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Emperor Xizong sent envoys to bestow on the Emperor an iron writ of immunity; he also ordered the Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance Liu Chongwang to compose a stele of virtuous governance and bestow it on the Emperor.

units.zh: 閏月甲寅。
units.en: Intercalary month, jiayin day.
units.literal: Intercalary month, jiayin day.

units.zh: 帝請行營司馬李璠權知淮南留後，乃遣大將郭言領兵援送以赴揚州。
units.en: He asked that Li Fan serve as acting regent of Huainan and sent Guo Yan with an escort to Yangzhou.
units.literal: The Emperor requested that the campaign staff officer Li Fan be made acting regent of Huainan; he then sent the great general Guo Yan to lead troops in escort to Yangzhou.

units.zh: 文德元年正月，帝率師東赴淮海，行次宋州，聞楊行密已拔揚州，遂還。
units.en: In Wende 1.1 he marched east toward Huaihai, but at Songzhou learned Yang Xingmi had already taken Yangzhou and turned back.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Wende, the emperor led his army east toward Huaihai; when he reached Songzhou, he heard that Yang Xingmi had already taken Yangzhou, and so returned.

units.zh: 是時，李璠、郭言行至淮上，為徐戎所扼，不克進而還。
units.en: By then Li Fan and Guo Yan had reached the Huai, but Xu troops blocked them and they had to return.
units.literal: At this time Li Fan and Guo Yan had reached the Huai, but were blocked by the Xu army and returned without being able to advance.

units.zh: 帝怒，遂謀伐徐。
units.en: Angered, the emperor began planning a campaign against Xu.
units.literal: The emperor was angry and then planned to attack Xu.

units.zh: 二月丙戌，僖宗制以帝為蔡州四面行營都統，繇是諸鎮之師，皆受帝之節制。
units.en: On bingxu in the second month, Xizong made him commander-in-chief against Caizhou on all four fronts, bringing the armies of the circuits under his authority.
units.literal: On bingxu day in the second month, Xizong issued an edict making the emperor commander-in-chief of the field armies on all four sides of Caizhou; from then on the forces of the various circuits all came under his command.

units.zh: 三月庚子，昭宗卽位。
units.en: On gengzi in the third month, Zhaozong took the throne.
units.literal: On gengzi day in the third month, Zhaozong ascended the throne.

units.zh: 是月，蔡人石璠領萬眾以剽陳、亳，帝遣朱珍率精騎數千擒璠以獻。
units.en: That month Shi Fan of Cai plundered Chen and Bo with ten thousand men; the emperor sent Zhu Zhen with several thousand picked horsemen, who captured Fan and presented him.
units.literal: That month, Shi Fan of Cai led ten thousand men to plunder Chen and Bo; the emperor sent Zhu Zhen with several thousand elite cavalry, captured Fan, and presented him.

units.zh: 四月戊辰，魏博樂彥禎失律，其子從訓出奔相州，使來乞師。
units.en: On wuchen in the fourth month, Le Yanzhen of Weibo lost control of his forces; his son Congxun fled to Xiangzhou and begged for troops.
units.literal: On wuchen day in the fourth month, Le Yanzhen of Weibo lost control of discipline; his son Congxun fled to Xiangzhou and sent envoys to request troops.

units.zh: 帝遣朱珍領大軍濟河，連收黎陽、臨河二邑。
units.en: The emperor sent Zhu Zhen across the river with a large army; he took Liyang and Linhe in succession.
units.literal: The emperor sent Zhu Zhen to lead a large army across the river, and he successively took the two towns of Liyang and Linhe.

units.zh: 旣而魏軍推小校羅弘信為帥。
units.en: The Wei army then raised the junior officer Luo Hongxin as its commander.
units.literal: Thereafter the Wei army put forward the junior officer Luo Hongxin as commander.

units.zh: 弘信旣立，遣使送款于汴，帝優而納之，遂命班師。
units.en: Once installed, Hongxin sent envoys to Bian offering submission; the emperor received him warmly and ordered the army home.
units.literal: After Hongxin was installed, he sent envoys to Bian to offer allegiance; the emperor received him favorably and then ordered the army to withdraw.

units.zh: 是月，河南尹張全義襲李罕之于河陽，克之。
units.en: That month Zhang Quanyi of Henan attacked Li Hanzhi at Heyang and defeated him.
units.literal: That month, Zhang Quanyi, governor of Henan, attacked Li Hanzhi at Heyang and defeated him.

units.zh: 罕之單騎出奔，因乞師于太原，李克用為發萬騎以援之。
units.en: Hanzhi fled alone on horseback and appealed to Taiyuan; Li Keyong sent ten thousand horse to help him.
units.literal: Hanzhi fled alone on horseback and then requested troops from Taiyuan; Li Keyong sent ten thousand cavalry to aid him.

units.zh: 罕之遂收其眾，偕晉軍合勢，急攻河陽。
units.en: Hanzhi rallied his men, joined the Jin army, and attacked Heyang hard.
units.literal: Hanzhi then gathered his followers, joined forces with the Jin army, and pressed a fierce attack on Heyang.

units.zh: 全義危急，遣使求救于汴，帝遣丁會、牛存節、葛從周領兵赴之，大戰于溫縣，晉人與罕之俱敗。
units.en: Quanyi, in crisis, begged Bian for help; the emperor sent Ding Hui, Niu Cunjie, and Ge Congzhou, who fought a major battle at Wen County and defeated both the Jin army and Hanzhi.
units.literal: Quanyi was in grave danger and sent envoys to Bian for help; the emperor sent Ding Hui, Niu Cunjie, and Ge Congzhou with troops to go there, and in a great battle at Wen County the Jin forces and Hanzhi were both defeated.

units.zh: 于是河橋解圍，全義歸于河陽，因以丁會為河陽留後。
units.en: The siege of Heqiao was lifted, Quanyi returned to Heyang, and Ding Hui was made acting commissioner there.
units.literal: Thereupon the siege of Heqiao was lifted, Quanyi returned to Heyang, and Ding Hui was made acting military commissioner of Heyang.

units.zh: 五月己亥，昭宗制以帝檢校侍中，增食邑三千戶。
units.en: On jihai in the fifth month Zhaozong made him acting Palace Attendant and added three thousand households to his fief.
units.literal: On jihai day of the fifth month Emperor Zhaozong appointed the Emperor acting Palace Attendant and increased his fief by three thousand households.

units.zh: 戊辰，詔改帝鄉曰衣錦鄉，里曰沛王里。
units.en: On wuchen an edict renamed the emperor's home township "Returning in Splendor" and its ward "Prince of Pei."
units.literal: On wuchen day, an edict renamed the emperor's home township Yijin Township and its ward Peiwang Ward.

units.zh: 是月，帝以兼有洛、孟之地，無西顧之患，將大整師徒，畢力誅蔡。
units.en: That month, secure in Luo and Meng and free of western threats, he prepared to marshal his full strength against Cai.
units.literal: That month, because the Emperor now held the lands of Luo and Meng and had no worry on the western front, he was about to reorganize his army in full strength to exterminate Cai.

units.zh: 會蔡人趙德諲舉漢南之地以歸於朝廷，且遣使送款於帝，仍誓戮力同討宗權。
units.en: Zhao Deyin of Cai then surrendered southern Han to the court, sent envoys to the emperor, and pledged to join him against Zongquan.
units.literal: It happened that the Cai leader Zhao Deyin offered the lands of southern Han to the court and moreover sent envoys to pledge loyalty to the Emperor, still vowing to join forces in attacking Zongquan.

units.zh: 帝表其事，朝廷因以德諲為蔡州四面副都統。
units.en: The emperor reported this, and the court made Deyin deputy commander on all four sides of Cai.
units.literal: The Emperor memorialized the matter; the court thereupon made Deyin Deputy Commander-in-Chief on the four sides of Cai.

units.zh: 又以河陽、保義、義昌三節度為帝行軍司馬，兼糧料應接使。
units.en: Heyang, Baoyi, and Yichang were also assigned as his campaign staff and grain-and-supply commissioners.
units.literal: The military governors of Heyang, Baoyi, and Yichang were also made the emperor's campaign staff officers and concurrently grain-and-supply commissioners.

units.zh: 至是，帝領諸侯之師會德諲以伐蔡賊于汝水之上，遂薄其城。
units.en: He then led the allied hosts with Deyin to the Ru River, where they pressed the Cai rebels against their walls.
units.literal: By this time the Emperor led the armies of the feudal lords to join Deyin in attacking the Cai bandits on the Ru River and pressed close to the city.

units.zh: 五日之內，樹二十八寨以環之，蓋象列宿之數也。
units.en: In five days he ringed the city with twenty-eight camps—the number of the lunar mansions.
units.literal: Within five days he raised twenty-eight stockades to encircle it, emulating the number of the lunar mansions.

units.zh: 時帝親臨矢石，一日，飛矢中其左腋，血漬單衣，顧謂左右曰：「勿泄。」
units.en: He stood in the arrow storm himself; one day a shaft struck his left armpit and blood soaked his tunic. He told his attendants, "Tell no one."
units.literal: At that time the Emperor personally came under flying arrows; one day a stray arrow struck his left armpit and blood soaked his single robe; he turned to those beside him and said, "Do not reveal this."

units.zh: 九月，以糧運不繼，遂班師。
units.en: In the ninth month, with supplies failing, he drew off the army.
units.literal: In the ninth month, because grain transport could not be sustained, he withdrew the army.

units.zh: 是時，帝知宗權殘孽不足為患，遂移兵以伐徐。
units.en: Judging Zongquan's remnants no longer dangerous, he turned his army against Xu.
units.literal: At that time the Emperor knew that Zongquan's remnant followers were no great trouble; he then shifted his troops to attack Xu.

units.zh: 十月，先遣朱珍領兵與時溥戰于吳康鎮，徐人大敗，連收豐、蕭二邑；
units.en: In the tenth month he sent Zhu Zhen against Shi Pu at Wukang; the Xu army broke, and Feng and Xiao fell in succession;
units.literal: In the tenth month he first sent Zhu Zhen to lead troops to fight Shi Pu at Wukang Post; the men of Xu suffered a great defeat, and he successively recovered the districts of Feng and Xiao;

units.zh: 溥攜散騎馳入彭門。
units.en: Pu fled on horseback into Pengcheng.
units.literal: Pu, clutching his seal of office, galloped into Peng Gate.

units.zh: 帝命分兵以攻宿州，刺史張友攜符印以降。
units.en: He sent columns against Suzhou; Prefect Zhang You came out with seal and ribbon to surrender.
units.literal: The Emperor ordered his forces divided to attack Suzhou; the prefect Zhang You came bearing his seal and ribbon to surrender.

units.zh: 既而徐人閉壁堅守，遂命龐師古屯兵守之而還。
units.en: The Xu men then shut themselves behind the walls; he left Pang Shigu to hold the siege and withdrew.
units.literal: Before long the men of Xu closed their walls and held firm; he then ordered Pang Shigu to garrison troops and hold them while he returned.

units.zh: 是月，蔡賊孫儒攻陷揚州，自稱淮南節度使。
units.en: That month Sun Ru of Cai took Yangzhou and proclaimed himself military governor of Huainan.
units.literal: That month the Cai bandit Sun Ru stormed Yangzhou and styled himself military governor of Huainan.

units.zh: 龍紀元年正月，龎師古攻陷宿遷縣，進軍于呂梁。
units.en: In Longji 1.1, Pang Shigu took Suqian County and advanced to Luliang.
units.literal: In the first month of Longji 1, Pang Shigu stormed Suqian County and advanced to Luliang.

units.zh: 時溥領軍二萬，晨壓師古之軍而陣，師古促戰，敗之，斬首二千餘級，溥復入于彭門。
units.en: Shi Pu came up at dawn with twenty thousand men, but Shigu forced battle, defeated him, took more than two thousand heads, and Pu retreated into Pengmen.
units.literal: Shi Pu led twenty thousand troops and in the morning pressed close to Shigu's army to form ranks; Shigu forced battle, defeated him, cut off more than two thousand heads, and Pu reentered Pengmen.

units.zh: 二月，蔡將申叢遣使來告，縛秦宗權于帳下，折其足而囚之矣。
units.en: In the second month the Cai general Shen Cong reported that he had bound Qin Zongquan in camp, broken his feet, and imprisoned him.
units.literal: In the second month, the Cai general Shen Cong sent envoys to report that he had bound Qin Zongquan beneath his tent, broken his feet, and imprisoned him.

units.zh: 帝卽日承制以叢為淮西留後。
units.en: That day the emperor used delegated authority to make Cong acting commissioner of Huaixi.
units.literal: That very day the emperor, acting under delegated authority, made Cong acting commissioner of Huaixi.

units.zh: 未幾，叢復為都將郭璠所殺。
units.en: Before long Cong was killed in turn by the general Guo Fan.
units.literal: Before long, Cong was in turn killed by the general Guo Fan.

units.zh: 是月，璠執宗權來獻，帝遣行軍司馬李璠、牙校朱克讓檻進于長安。
units.en: That month Guo Fan delivered Zongquan; the emperor sent Li Fan and Zhu Kerang to escort him in a cage to Chang'an.
units.literal: That month, Fan seized Zongquan and presented him; the emperor sent the campaign staff officer Li Fan and the guard officer Zhu Kerang to escort him in a cage to Chang'an.

units.zh: 旣至，昭宗御延喜樓受俘，卽斬宗權于獨柳樹下。
units.en: When he arrived, Zhaozong received the captive from Yanxi Tower and had Zongquan beheaded under the lone willow.
units.literal: After he arrived, Zhaozong mounted Yanxi Tower to receive the captive, and Zongquan was immediately beheaded beneath the solitary willow.

units.zh: 蔡州平。
units.en: Caizhou was pacified.
units.literal: Caizhou was pacified.

units.zh: 昭宗詔加帝食實封一百戶，賜莊宅各一區。
units.en: Zhaozong granted him another hundred households of real fief income, along with an estate and a residence.
units.literal: Zhaozong issued an edict adding one hundred households of real fief income to the emperor and granting him one estate and one residence.

units.zh: 三月，又加帝檢校太尉、兼中書令，進封東平王，賞平蔡之功也。
units.en: In the third month he was promoted to acting Grand Commandant and Director of the Secretariat and advanced to Prince of Dongping, a reward for pacifying Cai.
units.literal: In the third month, he further promoted the emperor to acting Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat and advanced his title to Prince of Dongping, rewarding his merit in pacifying Cai.

units.zh: 大順元年四月丙辰，宿州小將張筠逐刺史張紹光，擁眾以附時溥。
units.en: In Dashun 1.4, on bingchen, Zhang Yun, a junior officer at Suzhou, drove out Prefect Zhang Shaoguang and went over to Shi Pu.
units.literal: On bingchen day of the fourth month of the first year of Dashun, the Suzhou minor officer Zhang Yun expelled the prefect Zhang Shaoguang and led the masses to join Shi Pu.

units.zh: 帝率親軍討之，殺千餘人，筠遂堅守。
units.en: The emperor marched in person, killed more than a thousand men, and Yun held the walls.
units.literal: The Emperor led his personal army to attack him, killed more than a thousand men, and Yun then held firm behind his walls.

units.zh: 乙卯，時溥出兵暴碭山縣，帝遣朱友裕以兵襲之，敗徐軍三千餘眾，獲沙陀援軍石君和等三十人，斬於宿州城下。
units.en: On yimao Shi Pu raided Dangshan; the emperor sent Zhu Youyu, broke three thousand Xu troops, and beheaded thirty captives—including the Shatuo officer Shi Junhe—below the walls of Suzhou.
units.literal: On yimao day Shi Pu sent troops to raid Dangshan County; the Emperor sent Zhu Youyu with troops to strike them, defeated more than three thousand men of the Xu army, captured the Shatuo relief officer Shi Junhe and thirty others, and beheaded them below the wall of Suzhou.

units.zh: 六月辛酉，淮南孫儒遣使修好於帝，帝表其事，請以淮南節度授於儒焉。
units.en: On xinyou in the sixth month Sun Ru sent envoys seeking peace; the emperor memorialized that Huainan be granted to him.
units.literal: On xinyou day of the sixth month Sun Ru of Huainan sent envoys to seek good relations with the Emperor; the Emperor memorialized the matter and requested that the Huainan governorship be granted to Ru.

units.zh: 辛未，昭宗命帝為宣義軍節度使，充河東東面行營招討使，時朝廷宰臣張濬將兵討太原故也。
units.en: On xinwei Zhaozong made him military governor of Xuanyi and commander of the eastern campaign against Hedong, for Chief Minister Zhang Jun was marching on Taiyuan.
units.literal: On xinwei day, Zhaozong appointed the emperor military governor of Xuanyi and commander of the eastern field army against Hedong, because the court's chief minister Zhang Jun was then leading troops to attack Taiyuan.

units.zh: 八月甲寅，昭義都將馮霸殺沙陀所署節度使李克恭來降，帝請河陽節度使朱崇節為潞州留後。
units.en: On jiayin in the eighth month Feng Ba of Zhaoyi killed Li Kegong, the Shatuo appointee, and surrendered; the emperor asked that Zhu Chongjie of Heyang hold Luzhou.
units.literal: On jiayin day in the eighth month, Feng Ba, a general of Zhaoyi, killed Li Kegong, the military governor appointed by the Shatuo, and came to surrender; the emperor requested that Zhu Chongjie, military governor of Heyang, be made acting commissioner of Luzhou.

units.zh: 戊辰，李克用自率蕃漢步騎數萬以圍潞州，帝遣葛從周率驍勇之士，夜中銜枚犯圍而入於潞。
units.en: On wuchen Li Keyong himself invested Luzhou with tens of thousands of steppe and Chinese horse and foot; the emperor sent Ge Congzhou with picked men to slip through the siege at midnight, gags in their mouths.
units.literal: On wuchen day Li Keyong himself led tens of thousands of steppe and Han infantry and cavalry to besiege Lu Prefecture; the Emperor sent Ge Congzhou with fierce warriors to enter Lu at midnight with gags in their mouths, breaking through the encirclement.

units.zh: 九月壬寅，帝至河陽，遣都將李讜引軍趨澤、潞，行至馬牢川，為晉人所敗。
units.en: On renyin in the ninth month he reached Heyang and sent General Li Dang toward Ze and Lu; at Malao River the Jin army defeated him.
units.literal: On renyin day in the ninth month, the emperor reached Heyang and sent the general Li Dang to lead troops toward Ze and Lu; when they reached Malao River, they were defeated by the Jin forces.

units.zh: 帝又遣朱友裕、張全義率精兵至鄆州北以為應援。
units.en: He sent Zhu Youyu and Zhang Quanyi with elite troops north of Yunzhou as reinforcement.
units.literal: The Emperor again sent Zhu Youyu and Zhang Quanyi with elite troops to the north of Yun Prefecture as relief.

units.zh: 既而崇節、從周棄潞來歸。
units.en: Soon Chongjie and Congzhou abandoned Luzhou and came home.
units.literal: Before long Chongjie and Congzhou abandoned Lu and returned.

units.zh: 戊申，帝廷責諸將敗軍之罪，斬李讜、李重胤以狥，遂班師焉。
units.en: On wushen he rebuked his generals in open court for the defeat, executed Li Dang and Li Chongyin as examples, and withdrew.
units.literal: On wushen day, the emperor rebuked the generals in open court for the army's defeat, executed Li Dang and Li Chongyin as a warning, and then withdrew the army.

units.zh: 十月乙酉，帝自河陽赴滑臺。
units.en: On yiyou in the tenth month he went from Heyang to Huatai.
units.literal: On yiyou day of the tenth month, the emperor went from Heyang to Huatai.

units.zh: 時奉詔將討太原，先遣使假道于魏，魏人不從。
units.en: Under orders to attack Taiyuan, he first asked passage through Wei; Wei refused.
units.literal: At that time, having received the edict to campaign against Taiyuan, he first sent envoys to request passage through Wei; the men of Wei would not agree.

units.zh: 先是，帝遣行人雷鄴告糴于魏，既而為牙軍所殺。
units.en: Earlier he had sent Lei Ye to Wei to buy grain; the guard soldiery killed him.
units.literal: Earlier the Emperor had sent the envoy Lei Ye to announce a grain purchase in Wei; afterward he was killed by the yajun.

units.zh: 羅宏信懼，故不敢從命，遂通好於太原。
units.en: Luo Hongxin, in fear, defied the order and made peace with Taiyuan instead.
units.literal: Luo Hongxin was afraid and therefore dared not obey the command; he then opened good relations with Taiyuan.

units.zh: 十二月辛丑，帝遣丁會、葛從周率眾渡河取黎陽、臨河，又令龐師古、霍存下淇門、衛縣，帝徐以大軍繼其後。
units.en: On xinchou in the twelfth month Ding Hui and Ge Congzhou crossed the river and took Liyang and Linhe; Pang Shigu and Huo Cun took Qimen and Weixian; the emperor followed with the main host.
units.literal: On xinchou day of the twelfth month the Emperor sent Ding Hui and Ge Congzhou to lead the masses across the river and take Liyang and Linhe; he also ordered Pang Shigu and Huo Cun to descend on Qimen and Wei County, while the Emperor himself slowly followed with the main army.

units.zh: 二年春正月，魏軍屯于內黃。
units.en: In the second year, first month, the Wei army camped at Neihuang.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year the Wei army encamped at Neihuang.

units.zh: 丙辰，帝與之接戰，自內黃至永定橋，魏軍五敗，斬首萬餘級。
units.en: On bingchen he fought them from Neihuang to Yongding Bridge; the Wei army lost five battles and more than ten thousand heads.
units.literal: On bingchen day the Emperor joined battle with them from Neihuang to Yongding Bridge; the Wei army was defeated five times and more than ten thousand heads were cut off.

units.zh: 羅宏信懼，遣使持厚幣請和。
units.en: Luo Hongxin, terrified, sent envoys with rich gifts to sue for peace.
units.literal: Luo Hongxin was afraid and sent envoys bearing rich gifts to sue for peace.

units.zh: 帝命止其焚掠而歸其俘，宏信由是感悅而聽命焉。
units.en: The emperor halted the burning, returned prisoners, and Hongxin submitted in gratitude.
units.literal: The Emperor ordered that burning and plunder cease and captives be returned; Hongxin was thereby moved to gratitude and submitted to his commands.

units.zh: 乃收軍屯於河上。
units.en: He then withdrew and camped on the riverbank.
units.literal: He then withdrew the army and encamped on the river bank.

units.zh: 八月己丑，帝遣丁會急攻宿州，刺史張筠堅守其壁，會乃率眾於州東築堰，壅汴水以浸其城。
units.en: On jichou in the eighth month Ding Hui pressed Suzhou; Prefect Zhang Yun held the walls while Hui's men built a dam east of the city and diverted the Bian River to flood it.
units.literal: On jichou day of the eighth month the Emperor sent Ding Hui to press the attack on Suzhou; the prefect Zhang Yun held firm behind his walls; Hui then led the masses to build a dam east of the prefecture and dammed the Bian River to flood the city.

units.zh: 十月壬午，筠遂降，宿州平。
units.en: On renyang in the tenth month Yun surrendered and Suzhou was pacified.
units.literal: On renyang day of the tenth month Yun then surrendered and Suzhou was pacified.

units.zh: 十一月丁未，曹州裨將郭紹賓殺刺史郭饒，舉郡來降。
units.en: On dingwei in the eleventh month Guo Shaobin, a Cao officer, killed Prefect Guo Rao and surrendered the commandery.
units.literal: On dingwei day of the eleventh month the Cao vice-general Guo Shaobin killed the prefect Guo Rao and led the whole prefecture to surrender.

units.zh: 是月，徐將劉知俊率眾二千來降，自是徐軍不振。
units.en: That month Liu Zhijun of Xu came over with two thousand men, and Xu's strength never recovered.
units.literal: That month the Xu general Liu Zhijun led two thousand men to surrender; from this the Xu army no longer flourished.

units.zh: 十二月，兗州朱瑾領軍三萬寇單父，帝遣丁會領大軍襲之，敗于金鄉界，殺二萬餘眾，瑾單馬遁去。
units.en: In the twelfth month Zhu Jin of Yan raided Shanfu with thirty thousand men; Ding Hui struck him at Jinxiang, killed more than twenty thousand, and Jin fled alone on horseback.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Zhu Jin of Yan led thirty thousand men to raid Shanfu; the emperor sent Ding Hui with a large army to attack him, defeated him on the Jinxiang border, killed more than twenty thousand men, and Jin fled alone on horseback.

units.zh: 景福元年正月，遣丁會于兗州界徙其民數千戶于許州。
units.en: In Jingfu 1.1 he sent Ding Hui to the Yan border and relocated several thousand households to Xuzhou.
units.literal: In the first month of Jingfu 1, he sent Ding Hui to the Yan Prefecture border to move several thousand households of its people to Xuzhou.

units.zh: 二月戊寅，帝親征鄆，先遣朱友裕屯軍于斗門。
units.en: On wuyin in the second month he personally attacked Yun, first sending Zhu Youyu to garrison Doumen.
units.literal: On wuyin day in the second month, the emperor personally campaigned against Yun and first sent Zhu Youyu to station troops at Doumen.

units.zh: 甲申，次衞南，有飛鳥止于峻堞之上，鳴噪甚厲，副使李璠曰：「將有不如意之事。」
units.en: On jiashen he halted at Weinan. A bird perched on the high battlements and cried sharply; Deputy Commissioner Li Fan said, "Something will go wrong."
units.literal: On jiashen day, he halted at Weinan; a flying bird perched atop the high battlements and cried out harshly, and Deputy Commissioner Li Fan said, "Something unwelcome is about to happen."

units.zh: 是夜，鄆州朱瑾率步騎萬人襲朱友裕于斗門，友裕拔軍南去。
units.en: That night Zhu Jin of Yunzhou attacked Zhu Youyu at Doumen with ten thousand foot and horse, and Youyu pulled south.
units.literal: That night, Zhu Jin of Yunzhou led ten thousand infantry and cavalry to attack Zhu Youyu at Doumen, and Youyu withdrew his army south.

units.zh: 乙酉，帝晨救斗門，不知友裕之退，前至斗門者皆為鄆人所殺。
units.en: On yiyou he hurried to relieve Doumen at dawn, unaware Youyu had withdrawn; everyone who reached Doumen first was killed by Yun troops.
units.literal: On yiyou day, the emperor went at dawn to relieve Doumen; not knowing that Youyu had withdrawn, those who went ahead to Doumen were all killed by the men of Yun.

units.zh: 帝追襲鄆人至瓠河，不及，遂頓兵于村落間。
units.en: He pursued the Yun men to the Hu River but could not catch them, then halted among the villages.
units.literal: The emperor pursued the men of Yun as far as the Hu River but did not catch them, and so halted his army among the villages.

units.zh: 時朱瑄尚在濮州。
units.en: Zhu Xuan was still at Puzhou.
units.literal: At this time Zhu Xuan was still in Puzhou.

units.zh: 丁亥，遇朱瑄率兵將歸于鄆，遂來衝擊。
units.en: On dinghai he met Zhu Xuan leading troops back to Yun, and Xuan charged him.
units.literal: On dinghai day, he encountered Zhu Xuan leading troops back toward Yun, and Xuan came on to attack.

units.zh: 帝策馬南馳，為賊所追甚急，前有浚溝，躍馬而過，張歸厚援矟力戰于其後，乃免。
units.en: The emperor galloped south with the enemy close behind; he leapt a deep ditch, and Zhang Guihou fought hard with his spear behind him, allowing him to escape.
units.literal: The emperor whipped his horse and fled south, with the enemy pressing him hard; a deep ditch lay ahead, and he leapt his horse over it, while Zhang Guihou took up his spear and fought fiercely behind him, so the emperor escaped.

units.zh: 時李璠與都將數人皆為鄆軍所殺。
units.en: Li Fan and several generals were killed by the Yun army.
units.literal: At this time Li Fan and several generals were all killed by the Yun army.

units.zh: 五月丙午，遣朱克讓率眾暴兗、鄆之麥。
units.en: On bingwu in the fifth month he sent Zhu Kerang to ravage the wheat fields of Yan and Yun.
units.literal: On bingwu day in the fifth month, he sent Zhu Kerang to lead troops in destroying the wheat of Yan and Yun.

units.zh: 十一月，遣朱友裕率兵攻濮州，下之，擒刺史邵儒以獻，濮州平。
units.en: In the eleventh month he sent Zhu Youyu against Puzhou; Youyu took it, captured Prefect Shao Ru, and Puzhou was pacified.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, he sent Zhu Youyu to lead troops to attack Puzhou; he took it, captured Prefect Shao Ru and presented him, and Puzhou was pacified.

units.zh: 遂命移軍伐徐州。
units.en: He then turned the army against Xuzhou.
units.literal: He then ordered the army shifted to attack Xuzhou.

units.zh: 二年四月丁丑，師古下彭門，梟溥首以獻。
units.en: In the second year, on dingchou in the fourth month, Shigu took Pengmen and sent up Shi Pu's head.
units.literal: On dingchou day in the fourth month of the second year, Shigu took Pengmen and presented Pu's head.

units.zh: 八月，帝遣龎師古移兵攻兗，駐于曲阜，與朱瑾屢戰，皆敗之。
units.en: In the eighth month he sent Pang Shigu against Yan; camped at Qufu, Pang defeated Zhu Jin again and again.
units.literal: In the eighth month, the emperor sent Pang Shigu to move troops to attack Yan; he stationed them at Qufu, fought Zhu Jin repeatedly, and defeated him each time.

units.zh: 十二月，師古遣先鋒葛從周引軍以攻齊州，刺史朱威告急於兗、鄆。
units.en: In the twelfth month Pang sent Ge Congzhou against Qizhou; Prefect Zhu Wei cried for aid to Yan and Yun.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Shigu sent the vanguard Ge Congzhou to lead troops and attack Qi Prefecture; the prefect Zhu Wei sent urgent word to Yan and Yun.

units.zh: 既而朱瑄以援兵至，遂固其壘。
units.en: Zhu Xuan came with relief and fortified his camp.
units.literal: Before long Zhu Xuan came with relief troops and then fortified his camp.

units.zh: 乾甯元年二月，帝親領大軍由鄆州東路北次於魚山。
units.en: In Qianning 1.2 the emperor led his main force east from Yanzhou and halted at Yushan.
units.literal: In the second month of the first year of Qianning the Emperor personally led the main army east along the road from Yun Prefecture and halted at Yushan.

units.zh: 朱瑄覘知，即以兵徑至，且圖速戰。
units.en: Zhu Xuan learned of it, marched straight at him, and sought a quick fight.
units.literal: Zhu Xuan detected it and came straight on, moreover seeking a swift battle.

units.zh: 帝整軍出寨，時瑄、瑾已陣於前，須臾，東南風大起，我軍旌旗失次，甚有懼色，即令騎士揚鞭呼嘯。
units.en: He drew up outside the camp while Xuan and Jin were already formed before him. A fierce southeast wind threw his banners into confusion and fear spread; he ordered his horsemen to crack their whips and shout.
units.literal: The Emperor arrayed his army and went out of the stockade; at that time Xuan and Jin had already formed their battle lines in front; in a moment a great southeast wind arose, our army's banners and flags lost their order, and there was much fear; he thereupon ordered the horsemen to raise their whips and shout.

units.zh: 俄而西北風驟發，時兩軍皆在草莽中，帝因令縱火。
units.en: Soon a northwest gale rose. Both armies stood in dry grass; the emperor ordered the field set ablaze.
units.literal: Before long a northwest wind suddenly sprang up; at that time both armies were in the grass and scrub; the Emperor thereupon ordered fire set.

units.zh: 既而煙焰亙天，乘勢以攻賊陣，瑄、瑾大敗。
units.en: Smoke blotted out the sky; he drove into the enemy line and broke Xuan and Jin completely.
units.literal: Before long smoke and flames filled the sky; seizing the momentum he attacked the rebel battle lines, and Xuan and Jin suffered a great defeat.

units.zh: 殺萬餘人，餘眾擁入清河，因築京觀於魚山之下，駐軍數日而還。
units.en: He killed more than ten thousand; the rest were driven into the Qing River. He raised a victory mound below Yushan, camped several days, and withdrew.
units.literal: More than ten thousand were killed; the remainder were driven into the Qing River; he then built a victory mound below Yushan, encamped several days, and returned.

units.zh: 二年正月癸亥，遣朱友恭帥師復伐兗，遂塹而圍之。
units.en: On guihai in the second year, first month, he sent Zhu Yougong to besiege Yan with trenches.
units.literal: On guihai day of the first month of the second year he sent Zhu Yougong to lead troops again to attack Yan and thereupon invested it with trenches.

units.zh: 未幾，朱瑄自鄆率步騎援糧欲入于兗，友恭設伏以敗之，盡奪其餉于高吳，因擒蕃將安福順、安福慶。
units.en: Soon Zhu Xuan marched from Yanzhou with grain for the relief of Yan; Yougong ambushed him at Gaowu, seized the supplies, and captured the barbarian generals An Fushun and An Fuqing.
units.literal: Before long Zhu Xuan led infantry and cavalry from Yun with relief grain intending to enter Yan; Yougong set an ambush and defeated them, seizing all their provisions at Gaowu, and thereby captured the barbarian generals An Fushun and An Fuqing.

units.zh: 二月己酉，帝領親軍屯于單父，以為友恭之援。
units.en: On jiyou in the second month he camped at Shanfu to support Yougong.
units.literal: On jiyou day of the second month the Emperor led his personal army to encamp at Shanfu as relief for Yougong.

units.zh: 四月，濠、壽二州復為楊行密所陷。
units.en: In the fourth month Yang Xingmi retook Hao and Shou.
units.literal: In the fourth month Hao and Shou were again lost to Yang Xingmi.

units.zh: 是時，太原遣將史儼兒、李承嗣以萬騎馳入於鄆。
units.en: Taiyuan then sent Shi Yan'er and Li Chengsi with ten thousand horsemen into Yanzhou.
units.literal: At that time Taiyuan sent the generals Shi Yan'er and Li Chengsi with ten thousand horsemen galloping into Yun.

units.zh: 朱友恭遂歸於汴。
units.en: Zhu Yougong withdrew to Bian.
units.literal: Zhu Yougong thereupon returned to Bian.

units.zh: 八月，帝領親軍伐鄆，至大仇，遣前軍挑戰，設伏於梁山以待之。
units.en: In the eighth month he marched on Yanzhou as far as Daqiu, sent his vanguard to provoke battle, and laid an ambush at Liangshan.
units.literal: In the eighth month the Emperor led his personal army to attack Yun, reaching Daqiu; he sent the vanguard to offer challenge and set an ambush at Liangshan to await them.

units.zh: 既而獲蕃將史完府，奪馬數百匹。
units.en: He captured the barbarian officer Shi Wanfu and took several hundred horses.
units.literal: Before long they captured the barbarian general Shi Wanfu and seized several hundred horses.

units.zh: 朱瑄脫身遁去，復入於鄆。
units.en: Zhu Xuan escaped and fled back into Yanzhou.
units.literal: Zhu Xuan slipped away and fled, again entering Yun.

units.zh: 十月，帝駐軍于鄆，齊州刺史朱瓊遣使請降，瓊即瑾之從父兄也。
units.en: In the tenth month he camped at Yanzhou; Zhu Qiong of Qizhou offered surrender—he was Zhu Jin's elder cousin.
units.literal: In the tenth month the Emperor encamped at Yun; the Qi Prefecture prefect Zhu Qiong sent envoys to request surrender—Qiong was Jin's elder cousin.

units.zh: 帝因移軍至兗，瓊果來降。
units.en: He moved to Yan, and Qiong came in as promised.
units.literal: The Emperor thereupon shifted his army to Yan; Qiong indeed came to surrender.

units.zh: 未幾，瓊為朱瑾所紿，掠而殺之，帝即以其弟玭為齊州防禦使。
units.en: Soon Jin tricked Qiong, seized him, and killed him; the emperor appointed his younger brother Min defender of Qizhou.
units.literal: Before long Qiong was deceived by Zhu Jin, seized and killed; the Emperor thereupon made his younger brother Min defense commissioner of Qi Prefecture.

units.zh: 十一月，朱瑄復遣將賀瓌、柳存及蕃將何懷寶等萬餘人以襲曹州，庶解兗州之圍也。
units.en: In the eleventh month Zhu Xuan sent He Gui, Liu Cun, and the foreign general He Huaibao with more than ten thousand men to raid Cao and break the siege of Yan.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, Zhu Xuan again sent the generals He Gui and Liu Cun and the foreign general He Huaibao, with more than ten thousand men, to raid Cao Prefecture, hoping thereby to relieve the siege of Yan.

units.zh: 帝知之，自兗領軍策馬先路至鉅野南，追而敗之，殺戮將盡，生擒賀瓌、柳存、何懷寶及賊黨三千餘人。
units.en: Forewarned, he rode ahead from Yan to south of Juye, overtook them, slaughtered nearly all, and took He Gui, Liu Cun, He Huaibao, and more than three thousand rebels alive.
units.literal: The emperor learned of it, led the army from Yan, spurred ahead to south of Juye, pursued and defeated them, killed nearly all of them, and captured alive He Gui, Liu Cun, He Huaibao, and more than three thousand of the rebel party.

units.zh: 是日申時，狂風暴起，沙塵沸湧，帝曰：「此乃殺人未足耳。」
units.en: At the shen hour that day a wild wind rose and sand boiled up. The emperor said, "This means we have not killed enough."
units.literal: At the shen hour of that day a fierce wind suddenly arose and sand and dust boiled up; the Emperor said, "This means the killing is not yet enough."

units.zh: 遂下令盡殺所獲囚俘，風亦止焉。
units.en: He ordered every captive killed, and the wind fell still.
units.literal: He thereupon ordered that all the prisoners taken be put to death, and the wind then ceased.

units.zh: 翼日，縶賀瑰等以示於兗。
units.en: The next day he bound He Gui and the others and paraded them before Yan.
units.literal: The next day he bound He Gui and the others and displayed them at Yan.

units.zh: 帝素知瑰名，乃釋之，惟斬何懷寶於兗城之下，乃班師。
units.en: Knowing Gui's name, he spared him, beheaded only He Huaibao below the walls of Yan, and withdrew.
units.literal: The Emperor had long known Gui's name; he then released him, beheading only He Huaibao below the wall of Yan, and thereupon withdrew the army.

units.zh: 十二月，葛從周領兵復伐兗。
units.en: In the twelfth month Ge Congzhou marched again against Yan.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Ge Congzhou led troops again to attack Yan.

units.zh: 既至，與朱瑾戰於壘下，殺千餘眾，擒其將孫漢筠已下二十人，遂旋師。
units.en: On arrival he fought Zhu Jin at the ramparts, killed more than a thousand, captured Sun Hanjun and twenty officers, and withdrew.
units.literal: Once he arrived, he fought Zhu Jin below the stockade, killed more than a thousand men, captured the general Sun Hanjun and twenty men below him, and then withdrew the army.

units.zh: 三年正月，河東李克用旣破邠州，欲謀爭霸，乃遣蕃將張汚落以萬騎寨于河北之莘縣，聲言欲救兗、鄆。
units.en: In the first month of the third year Li Keyong of Hedong, having seized Binzhou and bent on hegemony, sent the foreign general Zhang Wuluo with ten thousand horse to camp at Shen County in Hebei, claiming he would relieve Yan and Yun.
units.literal: In the first month of the third year, after Li Keyong of Hedong had taken Binzhou and sought to contend for supremacy, he sent the foreign general Zhang Wuluo with ten thousand cavalry to camp at Shen County in Hebei, announcing that he intended to relieve Yan and Yun.

units.zh: 魏博節度使羅弘信患之，使來求援。
units.en: Weibo's governor Luo Hongxin, alarmed, begged for help.
units.literal: Luo Hongxin, military governor of Weibo, was troubled by this and sent envoys requesting aid.

units.zh: 二月，帝領親軍屯于單父，會寒食，帝乃親拜文穆皇帝陵于碭山縣午溝里。
units.en: In the second month he camped his personal army at Shanfu; during Cold Food he visited Emperor Wenmu's tomb at Wugou in Dangshan County.
units.literal: In the second month, the emperor led his personal army to camp at Shanfu; it coincided with the Cold Food festival, and the emperor personally paid respects at Emperor Wenmu's tomb in Wugou Ward, Dangshan County.

units.zh: 四月辛酉，河東水泛漲，將壞滑城，帝令決隄岸以分其勢為二河，夾滑城而東，為害滋甚。
units.en: On xinyou in the fourth month the Hedong waters flooded and threatened Huazhou. He breached the dikes to split the flood into two channels east of the city, which only worsened the damage.
