units.literal: On xinyou day in the fourth month, the waters in Hedong flooded and threatened to destroy Hua city; the emperor ordered the embankments cut to divide their force into two rivers east of Hua city, which made the damage still worse.

units.zh: 是月，帝遣許州刺史朱友恭領兵萬人渡淮，以便宜從事。
units.en: That month he sent Xu Prefect Zhu Yougong with ten thousand men across the Huai with discretionary authority.
units.literal: That month the Emperor sent Zhu Yougong, prefect of Xu Prefecture, to lead ten thousand men across the Huai to act as circumstances required.

units.zh: 時黃、鄂二州累遣使求援，故有是行。
units.en: Huang and E prefectures had repeatedly begged for aid, which prompted the expedition.
units.literal: At that time Huang and E prefectures repeatedly sent envoys begging aid, and therefore this expedition was made.

units.zh: 五月，命葛從周統軍屯于洹水，以備蕃軍。
units.en: In the fifth month he stationed Ge Congzhou at Huanshui to block the barbarian army.
units.literal: In the fifth month he ordered Ge Congzhou to command the army encamped at Huanshui to guard against the barbarian forces.

units.zh: 六月，李克用帥蕃漢諸軍營於斥丘，遣其男落落將鐵林小兒三千騎薄于洹水，從周與戰，大敗之，生擒落落以獻。
units.en: In the sixth month Keyong camped at Chiqu and sent his son Luoluo with three thousand Iron Forest horsemen against Huanshui; Congzhou crushed them and presented Luoluo alive.
units.literal: In the sixth month Li Keyong led the barbarian and Han armies to camp at Chiqu, sent his son Luoluo to lead three thousand Iron Forest youths in a dash against Huanshui; Congzhou fought them and inflicted a great defeat, capturing Luoluo alive and presenting him.

units.zh: 克用悲駭，請修舊好以贖其子，帝不許，遂執落落送于羅宏信，斬之。
units.en: Keyong, stricken, offered peace to ransom his son; the emperor refused and sent Luoluo to Luo Hongxin, who beheaded him.
units.literal: Keyong was grieved and shocked; he requested to renew the old friendship to ransom his son; the Emperor did not consent, and therefore had Luoluo sent to Luo Hongxin and beheaded.

units.zh: 越七日，我軍還屯陽留以伐鄆。
units.en: Seven days later the army encamped at Yangliu to attack Yunzhou.
units.literal: Seven days later our army returned to camp at Yangliu to attack Yun.

units.zh: 八月，復壁于洹水。
units.en: In the eighth month he fortified Huanshui again.
units.literal: In the eighth month he again fortified at Huanshui.

units.zh: 是時，昭宗幸華州，遣使就加帝檢校太師，守中書令。
units.en: Zhaozong, then at Huazhou, promoted him to acting Grand Preceptor and guardian of the Secretariat.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Zhaozong was at Hua Prefecture and sent envoys to add to the Emperor's titles Acting Grand Preceptor and Guardian of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 四年正月，帝以洹水之師大舉伐鄆。
units.en: In the first month of the fourth year he marched from Huanshui in force against Yunzhou.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year the Emperor with the army at Huanshui launched a great campaign against Yun.

units.zh: 辛卯，營于濟水之次，龐師古令諸將撤木為橋。
units.en: On xinmao day he camped on the Ji River; Pang Shigu had his officers build a bridge from felled timber.
units.literal: On xinmao day he encamped on the bank of the Ji River; Pang Shigu ordered the generals to tear down trees for a bridge.

units.zh: 乙未夜，師古以中軍先濟，聲振於鄆，朱瑄聞之，棄壁夜走。
units.en: On the night of yiwei, Shigu's center crossed first with a roar that shook Yunzhou; Zhu Xuan abandoned his walls and fled by night.
units.literal: On the night of yiwei day Shigu with the central army crossed first, and the sound shook Yun; Zhu Xuan heard it and abandoned his walls and fled by night.

units.zh: 葛從周逐之至中都北，擒瑄並其妻男以獻。
units.en: Ge Congzhou pursued him north of Zhongdu, captured Xuan with his wife and sons, and presented them.
units.literal: Ge Congzhou pursued him to north of Zhongdu, captured Xuan together with his wife and sons, and presented them.

units.zh: 尋斬汴橋下。
units.en: He was soon beheaded below the Bian Bridge.
units.literal: Soon he was beheaded below the Bian Bridge.

units.zh: 鄆州平。
units.en: Yunzhou fell.
units.literal: Yun Prefecture was pacified.

units.zh: 己亥，帝入于鄆，以朱友裕為鄆州兵馬留後。
units.en: On jihai he entered Yunzhou and made Zhu Youyu its military commissioner.
units.literal: On jihai day, the emperor entered Yun and made Zhu Youyu acting military commissioner of Yun Prefecture.

units.zh: 時帝聞朱瑾與史儼兒在豐沛間搜索糧饋，惟留康懷英守兗州，帝因乘勝遣葛從周以大軍襲兗。
units.en: Learning that Zhu Jin and Shi Yan'er were foraging between Feng and Pei while only Kang Huaiying held Yanzhou, he followed up the victory by sending Ge Congzhou with a large army to strike Yan.
units.literal: At this time the emperor heard that Zhu Jin and Shi Yan'er were searching for grain supplies between Feng and Pei and had left only Kang Huaiying to guard Yan Prefecture, so he took advantage of the victory and sent Ge Congzhou with a great army to attack Yan.

units.zh: 懷英聞鄆失守，俄又我軍大至，乃出降；
units.en: Huaiying heard Yun had fallen and the main army was upon him; he surrendered;
units.literal: Huaiying heard that Yun had fallen, and soon our great army arrived; he then came out to surrender;

units.zh: 朱瑾、史儼兒遂奔淮南。
units.en: Zhu Jin and Shi Yan'er fled to Huainan.
units.literal: Zhu Jin and Shi Yan'er then fled to Huainan.

units.zh: 兗、海、沂、密等州平。
units.en: Yan, Hai, Yi, and Mi were pacified.
units.literal: Yan, Hai, Yi, and Mi prefectures were pacified.

units.zh: 乃以葛從周為兗州留後。
units.en: He made Ge Congzhou military commissioner of Yanzhou.
units.literal: He then made Ge Congzhou military commissioner of Yan Prefecture.

units.zh: 五月丁丑，朱友恭遣使上言，大破淮寇于武昌，收復黃、鄂二州。
units.en: On dingchou day in the fifth month Zhu Yougong reported a great victory over the Huai rebels at Wuchang and the recovery of Huang and E.
units.literal: On dingchou day of the fifth month Zhu Yougong sent a memorial reporting a great defeat of the Huai bandits at Wuchang and the recovery of Huang and E prefectures.

units.zh: 八月，陝州節度使王珙遣使來乞師。
units.en: In the eighth month Wang Gong of Shanzhou begged for troops.
units.literal: In the eighth month Wang Gong, military governor of Shan Prefecture, sent envoys to beg troops.

units.zh: 是時，珙弟珂實為蒲帥，迭相憤怒，日尋干戈，而珙兵寡，故來求援。
units.en: Gong's brother Ke held Pu Prefecture; the brothers feuded daily; Gong's forces were few, so he asked for aid.
units.literal: At that time Gong's younger brother Ke was in fact governor of Pu; they mutually raged and daily sought battle; Gong's troops were few, and therefore he came to request aid.

units.zh: 帝遣張存敬、楊師厚等領兵赴陝，既而與蒲人戰於猗氏，大敗之。
units.en: He sent Zhang Cunjing and Yang Shihou to Shan; at Yishi they routed the Pu army.
units.literal: The Emperor sent Zhang Cunjing, Yang Shihou, and others to lead troops to Shan; soon they fought the men of Pu at Yishi and inflicted a great defeat.

units.zh: 九月，帝以兗、鄆既平，將士雄勇，遂大舉南征。
units.en: In the ninth month, with Yan and Yun secure and his army eager, he launched a great southern campaign.
units.literal: In the ninth month, because Yan and Yun were already pacified and officers and soldiers were fierce and brave, he then launched a great southern campaign.

units.zh: 命龐師古以徐、宿、宋、滑之師直趨清口，葛從周以兗、鄆、曹、濮之眾徑赴安豐。
units.en: Pang Shigu was to drive on Qingkou with the armies of Xu, Su, Song, and Hua; Ge Congzhou was to strike Anfeng with the forces of Yan, Yun, Cao, and Pu.
units.literal: He ordered Pang Shigu with the armies of Xu, Su, Song, and Hua to press straight on Qingkou, and Ge Congzhou with the masses of Yan, Yun, Cao, and Pu to march directly on Anfeng.

units.zh: 淮人遣朱瑾領兵以拒師古，因決水以浸軍，遂為淮人所敗，師古沒焉。
units.en: The Huai army sent Zhu Jin against Shigu, breached the dikes to flood his camp, and destroyed him; Shigu died.
units.literal: The men of Huai sent Zhu Jin to lead troops to resist Shigu; they therefore breached the water to inundate the army, and so were defeated by the men of Huai; Shigu perished.

units.zh: 葛從周行及濠梁，聞師古之敗，亦命班師。
units.en: Ge Congzhou, reaching Haoliang, heard of Shigu's defeat and ordered a retreat.
units.literal: Ge Congzhou, marching as far as Haoliang, heard of Shigu's defeat and also ordered withdrawal of the army.
